q: Why did sales drop on 9 October?
answer:
Net sales fell on 9 Oct to ₹53,880 (by order date), down 40.8% from ₹90,962 on 8 Oct — the drop was driven by far fewer orders, not less traffic. The diagnostic scan did not find a single upstream cause it can label as “the cause.”

- What changed, at a glance: Orders fell from 58 → 26 (−55.2%), pushing net sales down; Net AOV rose ₹1,568 → ₹2,072 (+32.1%) which softened the decline by about ₹14,881; sessions were steady 4,224 → 4,461 (+5.6%) so traffic did not explain the drop. Net sales usual level (a recent normal blend) is ~₹89,086, so 9 Oct sits below the normal range but not an extreme outlier.
- Where it broke: conversion dropped — conversion rate 1.35% → 0.56% (−52.8%), so the site/offer converted far worse on 9 Oct despite similar sessions. By ad: the ad “TH-222-WINGBIRD” fell sharply (net sales ₹8,931 → ₹1,101), and several other ads moved materially in both directions.
- What we can rule out: sessions did not move unusually, and the statistical test found no supported_cause among the drivers tested (ad spend, sessions, returns). The results show what moved (orders & conversion) but cannot attribute a single cause from the available data.

Worth checking: campaign/ad-level conversion and landing-page issues for 9 Oct (start with TH-222-WINGBIRD); check if any ad edits, landing-page changes or tracking breaks happened that day.
